role: CI guard (make scoring-governance; ci.yml, gates.yml): (1) the token `rankingWeight` may appear only under Emuqu/Sources/Analysis/CauseDetection/; (2) a hash of the numeric scoring constants must not change unless ScoringVersion.current changes.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Python: every Emuqu/Sources/**/*.swift outside CauseDetection/ is scanned line by line; any line containing `rankingWeight` (comments included) is a problem. Then for the two SCORING_SOURCES (exit 2 if missing): strip `//` comments, regex `static let NAME [: Type] = <numeric literal>` and feed sorted `file:NAME=VALUE` lines into sha256, truncated to 16 hex. Reads ScoringVersion.current (exit 2 if absent); exit 2 if baseline missing; baseline split into (version, hash) — a malformed baseline raises ValueError (traceback, exit 1). Problem when hash differs AND version equals recorded version. A changed hash WITH a version bump passes without the baseline being updated (baseline is never rewritten here). Exits 1 on problems, else prints 'clean'. Only numeric-literal `static let` in the two files are hashed: constants defined as expressions, arrays, instance lets, or literals in other scoring files (e.g. inline weights in calculators) are outside the hash.

flags.text: Version-on-change is enforced only for numeric-literal `static let` declarations in two files; a scoring weight changed anywhere else (or as an expression/array) changes scores without tripping the gate, so the header's 'whenever inputs, thresholds, or weights change' is broader than what is checked.
